purpose: Rule out any Helly-style or bounded-local-subset positivity theorem for the positive P0 principal-transversal coefficient carrier. Construct arbitrarily large bounded-occurrence minimally-unsatisfiable 2-CNFs for which every proper clause-subset coefficient is positive while the full target coefficient is zero.

family.occurrence_bound: Every variable occurs at most three times; all clauses have size two.

theorem_minimal_unsat.name: BOUNDED_OCCURRENCE_MINIMAL_UNSAT_CHAIN
proof: The first two clauses force x_1=true: if x_1=false they require a and NOT a simultaneously.
The implication chain (NOT x_i OR x_{i+1}) then forces x_2=...=x_n=true.
The last two clauses force x_n=false: if x_n=true they require b and NOT b simultaneously. Hence the full formula is UNSAT.
Delete one first forcing clause: choose x_1=false and set a to satisfy the remaining first clause; then set all later x_i=false, satisfying the chain and both terminal clauses.
Delete one last forcing clause symmetrically: choose all x_i=true and set b to satisfy the remaining terminal clause.

Delete an implication (NOT x_k OR x_{k+1}): set x_1=...=x_k=true and x_{k+1}=...=x_n=false; choose a,b arbitrarily to satisfy the now-compatible forcing pairs. Thus deleting any single clause makes the formula SAT.
Any proper subformula is contained in some one-clause deletion and is therefore SAT.

p0_coefficient_consequence.notation: For the v2.8 carrier let G_F(z)=det(I+KZ(z)) and W_J=[product_{C in J} z_C]G_F for clause subsets J.
p0_coefficient_consequence.identity: W_J counts sign-consistent one-witness-per-clause transversals for the subformula induced by J; therefore W_J>0 iff that subformula is SAT.
p0_coefficient_consequence.family_result: For every n>=2, W_all=0 but W_J>0 for every proper J subset of clauses.
p0_coefficient_consequence.strong_form: The failure persists with arbitrarily many clauses while every variable occurrence is at most three and every clause size is two.

killed: Any finite Helly number h such that positivity of all target coefficients on clause subsets of size at most h implies positivity of the full target coefficient.
Any monotone local-to-global rule saying that positivity of every proper squarefree clause coefficient forces the full coefficient positive.
Any bounded-radius/local-subformula obstruction search claimed complete for the P0 carrier without a genuinely global certificate.
not_killed: A global oriented-minor/Pfaffian cancellation identity using all clauses simultaneously.
A blossom-like contraction whose obstruction can span linearly many clauses.
A polynomial global minimax certificate not reducible to local coefficient positivity.

next_target.name: E8_GLOBAL_ORIENTED_P0_CLAW_CERTIFICATE_V3_4
next_target.directive: The exact decision information can be absent from every proper clause subset. Seek a polynomial-size global certificate or contraction using orientation/sign data across the whole instance. Reject bounded-local, finite-Helly, subset-rank, real-stability, and isolated-switch gadgets already closed by v2.9-v3.3.
